timeline.tweet: Realizing I don’t have friends because I push people away by ignoring them for fear they will leave and hurt me. Coming out of my comfort zone to bond with someone just to have them leave me like I dreaded. Feeling once again like something is being torn from me.
I wonder if she would have tried harder to keep me had she known the parents she was leaving me with never wanted my well-being. Just to satisfy their own needs and wants.
I know I can get a copy on my own. But it’s the act of her taking a piece of paper she knew was the most important thing to me and throwing it out like trash. That’s not love it’s selfish and mean.

The way my brain processed the loss of my birth mom was like death. As a child I’d created a false memory that she had passed. I fully believed it for years. Now that I am older I think it was easier to feel like she died then to admit she’d left me.

I want to so bad. But feel the same. I’m worried I’ll mess up and hurt someone. Never have I had someone understand this! 😅 I going to try driving school. If that doesn’t work I might never drive either!

It really does! It’s such a profound moment. It’s felt like heartbreak. I love my adoptive mother but she did have her faults. Words are powerful and can’t be taken back. She once told me she wished she never had adopted me. It has been a conflicted relationship trying to forgive

my b mom. She had associated everything “negative” about me to her and I couldn’t stand it and directed my anger towards b mom. Having our adoption used as a weapon against us Is something more common than not between adoptees.

Similar to that my a mom used to point out how awkward I am and the fact that I didn’t have many friends. When I was moving out she told me “Who are you moving with? No one wants you.” I am thankful she said this when I was an adult, don’t know if I’d have handled as a child.

I cracked last August. I had blocked out a lot of memories that were brought back by a traumatic event and just dropped the mask completely. Told my a mom about the abuse I suffered from her husband, a man underserving of the title “father” adoptive or not.

I started life out bouncing from the street with my b mom to a motel 6 with my b grandma. I’m pretty sure the jacket, shirt, and stuffed animals were given to me by the fosters, child services, or agency.
It’s a clear choice he made. Leaving you for them, I am so sorry😢 When experiencing abandonment it is extremely hard to trust others after that even when they are pure of heart and intention.

Being “too young” is also a reason my b mom was told she should relinquish me. Not to mention us being homeless, she tried to do what she thought was right by giving me a chance to have a home. Unfortunately the home came with an abuser I’m sure b mom never imagined.

I knew my a mom didn’t love me the same as her biological children when she completely cut me off for about a year at 19 for moving out. Only then to guilt trip me about how ungrateful I was for doing exactly what she willing helped her biological son do with no quarrel.

From what I was told my b mom lost visitation with me because she missed three visits for being in jail. She would have been around 22. A young woman left behind bars for a misdemeanor while they adopted me out. They completely forgot about her. She could have been helped.

My b mom lost visitation with me when I was in my first foster home. She came back for me though. Despite her addiction she tried to keep me. She got visitations back in 1995 swearing to fight for me but lost them for good by 96 for slipping up and ending up in jail.

In 5th grade they had us switch teachers for math after lunch to prepare us for multiple teachers in middle school. The teacher I got terrified me so much that I ditched her class for two MONTHS. The teacher had assumed I was a no show left on the roll call sheet.

When I found out my abuser was also abused all it did was anger me more because it was being said as his excuse. He went through it knowing how much it fucks you up and still willingly put me through the same. Thankfully I’m stronger than him and it hasn’t broken or changed me.

You have rights. I have rights. Adoptees rights have been ignored for so long. We should all be able to sue for them treating us as commodities and slaves. For being placed with abusers and forgotten. Knowing I was bought by abusers does a funny thing to my personality.
It’s really cruel. Abandoned even by the adoption agency. How is it legal to do children like this?! Laws need to be changed.. where is the justice ???

I was with my b mom until about 2 years old. We were most of the time homeless I was told. I was placed in a shelter home and then in a foster home until I was 4 when my adopters got me. I feel for baby you😔 thankful you survived.

I think it was easy with my great aunt but I know it will be hard with my b mom. A lot of my questions aren’t easy ones.. she lost me due to drugs and she may or may not still be using. I still want to find her even if she’s in a bad place. I just need to. Thank you H💕
I just officially cut off my adoptive mother. I’m a fucking wreck. Was I ever her daughter?! Then why has she chosen my abuser over me?

He passed away in 1995. I was already in the system since birth in 1993. I think about what my life would have been like had cps contacted my grandpa. I would have been in his care and after passing his sister would have taken me in. They knew of my grandpa but never notified him

Adoption did the same to me. Sexually abused by my adopter at 3 continuing for several years. Emotionally abused by both adopters for not fitting their image of me. Also alienated by the extended adoptive family while dealing with bullying from them. Adoption stole my happiness.

I am proud of you. I wish I had spoken up for myself sooner. He tried it with me once more last year, but as an adult I had found my voice and stood my ground and didn’t let him. That’s 12 years of silence that was killing me slowly. We have our own backs at the end of it.

These family therapy sessions and weird family bonding exercises didn’t happen until I was a bit older. But at first they had told them they shouldn’t hug/touch me because of previous abuse claims. So I went from no physical contact and lots of jealousy to full on smothering.

This is so touchy for me right now. My a mom is in denial over the abuse. Knows about it but swept it under the rug. Yet she tells me she’s my mother and loves me with her whole heart. But every night she goes back home and into bed with my abuser. How much of a mother is she?

Even more ironic, the 2nd fosters adopted me but also abused me. So they knew they were getting a ‘troubled’ child, were shocked I was a good girl, then still abused me! This paper trail calling me a prostitue really set me up for a fucked up life! What if it had said I was good?

Blessings to you, glad you survived❣️ My bio grandpa passed from heart complications at the age of 42. Only recently found out my heart is something I need to watch out for a little extra, since it runs in the family.

Two things come to mind: 1. That’s probably the thought process my abuser had when signing my adoption papers. 2. I feel so sad for the little girl who had to survive him, lose her mother to suicide, then grow up and find out that this is her bio ‘father’. HOW IS HE RUNNING?!

My heart goes out to all those affected! The pictures of the Guatemalan people being rescued or running with that look of pure desperation and fear on their faces raise the hair on my arms. It’s so sad.
“I guess we are all veterans in a way of the wars that have been fought within us and perhaps we can step through the doorway into peace at last.”

For me personally I agree with the statement because my adoptive mother adopted me for the same reason. She was grieving the fact that she had wanted another daughter but didn’t want to actually have a baby. Only I wasn’t the daughter she dreamed up so she verbally and-

The only thing I can find on my birth mom is an arrest record from last year September. Literally 30 minutes from me. It was a misdemeanor so she was let out within days. How should I go about searching with this info? Is it a dead end? So close but so far all at once. Bleh.
Just booking info and arrest date and time. It shows the jail she was booked at. I’m going to pm you.

My birth mom is a perfect example of this. It didn’t matter that she wanted to quit and wanted to keep me. It mattered that she hit her third strike and wasn’t present at our ‘last chance’ meeting for being in jail. So they took her rights! She was 20.

Imagine being told your mother didn’t show up to your last three visits because she chose a drug over you and also had to suffer the consequences such as jail time at 4yrs old. I always felt worthless because of this.

Understandable, I used to be average weight for my height and age then out of no where the stress destroyed my appetite. I lost 20 pounds in one month making me severely underweight. I felt disgusting and sickly looking. Since then I’ve had trouble gaining so I don’t like myself.

A reality of adoption. Some of us find graves at the end of our search. Bio parents, grand parents, even siblings gone.. puzzles pieces that could have fit perfectly to us that we will never be able to find. How do we make peace with the fact that they are gone and never met us?!

I believe so too theres nothing I could do about that. I reassured her that she was my mother that I was seeking answers only. I included her in everything up until recently because she has chosen to live with my abuser. She begs me not to go to the police.. but is that motherly?
DCFS also placed me with my abuser. Go figure😒 The whole organization needs to be looked into!

A close friend who I haven’t spoken to in a year wants to catch up and asks about my ‘parents’ and if we can go to their business. So I had to explain that he hurt me and in what way. That my ‘mother’ abandoned me for him after knowing he what he did. #truthishard

Hey so here’s a happy tweet. I’ve gained 10 pounds! This is huge for me as someone who has spent the last five years underweight and unhealthy. I’m actually feeling so much better! I finally feel good in my own body. It’s becoming easier to like myself.☺️

It’s really insane to me that as a descendant of people who brutally invaded this country she can look at the people crossing the border that her corrupt ancestors created after they took control of a country that was not theirs to begin with, and dehumanize them.

Oh the education system is a mess! At least for children and minors who have no choice. In high school I had ONE cool teacher who threw out the book we were supposed to learn from and fought to get a book with real info in it in the class. He went over a lot id never even known.

Going to be writing a letter to my late grandpa. Im finally going to visit his grave next week. Im nervous about it. I know it will be intense and emotional but I want and need to do this. He never knew about me and thats not either of our faults. I know he would have loved me.

Just finding out more details about my grandpas grave. He’s next to his parents, so I get to visit them all at once. It’s also the last place anyone from my bio family saw and spoke to my birth mom 13 years ago.

At 4yrs old I had made up this story that I was in a house fire that my birth mom died in. I fully believed this for a few years. My little mind only knew adoption as the death of my mother even though she was alive. Maybe it was easier to believe she died rather than left me.

I came into this world as a surprise to everyone. I was supposed to be just a stomach tumor. SURPRISE she was actually in labor about to deliver a premature baby. Unplanned for and later unwanted. It’s almost funny I hate surprises.

First to go to jail should be that despicable lady who lied on a child and caused his horrific death. She admitted to lying and in my opinion should have been thrown in jail right then and there. #JusticeForEmmettTill

It’s horrifying and I’m sorry you all went through that and lost your brother. These are the reasons why we speak out when someone casually says just adopt or foster they’ll be better off. No that’s not guaranteed. What is guaranteed is the loss and trauma that’s way too common.
It feels so good finally putting your foot down and standing up for yourself and others like your daughter. It felt empowering to finally say no and put an end to my abusers actions.

Oh I adored both my grandmas too! My a moms mother passed when I was little but my memories of her are very fond. My a mom would tell me not to ask for food from her. She’d make me food anyways and chastise my a mom. I even got a granny sweater at 6 to match her.😊

Sorry about both your losses. Grandma’s are angels in my opinion. I lost my other grandma almost three years ago. It was one of the hardest times for the whole family. She was also a really sweet lady. Too many illnesses and health issues took her too soon.
It’s got to be the worst form of betrayal and broken trust. The one person we thought would have our backs above everyone else but doesn’t. 💔

She’d made me feel worthless and guilty for not being the person she’d hoped I’d be. It was such a sin to be myself. I forgave her for all of this though. But I can’t forgive her for quite literally being in bed with my abuser. That’s where I drew the line. Me or him. She choose.

So I picked up the quarter that was at my feet and said, “no it’s not.” Then she lunges at me and we literally begin fist fighting over a quarter. She overpowers me as expected she was bigger and pushed my face into a fence holding my head there.-

Only one great aunt. The second person I messaged. She responded so fast. She was really close to my grandpa and he passed in 95’. She was super excited to get to know “his grandchild.” It’s been one thing I feel I was blessed with.
Adoption impacted my ability to trust. I don’t think I’ve %100 trusted anyone ever. Love is conditional and with love comes pain. How can I trust when everyone I ever truly loved hurt or left me?

Very much so! My grandpa passed at 42 from heart complications because heart problems and diabetes run in the family. Really made me worry because I get random heart palpitations when having my frequent anxiety attacks. So now I know to watch out for my heart and what I eat.

The pain will always be there no doubt. And I’m sorry you go through it too. I don’t like that they still have the title of being my parents. They don’t deserve it and if I can change that, I will. May not make me feel any better but I might be able to sigh of relief for a sec.
Legal human trafficking.

Realize that when someone speaks up it means you have to make the decision of cutting ties with the abuser or settle with losing the victims trust and your place in their life. Also that you don’t need to forgive to move on. CSA is unforgivable, it’s a serious violation.

I suffered so much wondering what was wrong with me that no one tried to keep me. Then to hear that they tried real hard and felt like a failure for losing me.. that’s crushing. This man is amazing. He kept searching for me... so many years later and he found me on twitter!

Same but in high school when I was on the softball team. She only made it to one game and it was to sit in the bleachers with shades on and a serious face. Only to tell me my godfather had passed away. I was so happy she’d finally made it but it wasn’t for me. For my godfather.

I felt like a burden too. She made it kind of clear she’d done me the favor of saving me and now I was always in the way or in the wrong. Embarrassing or dishonoring her. I wasn’t even surprised when she let it slip that she truly felt I was a disappointment and a burden.

Her husband took advantage of me for his personal satisfaction while she constantly belittled me for not being the idea she had of my sister. Adoption and my adopters caused my abuse and I will never applaud them nor be thankful.

I second this. I found my grandpas grave when I first searched.. I hoped and prayed it was the wrong guy. Recently found out I was right though and it’s been weird trying to settle with this confirmation.

My goal for the future is to move across state! Lol far far away from this place.

Two: birth last name, adopted last name. Soon to be three wether I marry or change it myself! Not entirely sure if I’d take back my birth last name. It all depends on my birth mom. If she’s a good person I’d want to, if not I don’t want any ties.
that it’s all lies and it seems a bit delusional. I used to just smile and nod. Now it’s different because she chooses my abuser over me.
